condo: ⭐️ D5 Clementi Rare 4 Bed Dual Key High Rental Yield

history.summary: This is ELTA (Clementi Avenue 1, 99LH new launch, D05) — a 4-bed dual-key, 1,313 sqft, $2.9M / $2,209 psf, ~640m from Clementi MRT (which gains a future Cross Island Line interchange, CR17). Strong location and CRL catalyst, and the dual-key format aids rental flexibility, but it's a $2.9M new-launch quantum at full pricing.
history.rating_rationale: ELTA sits on top of Clementi's transport node — existing EWL plus the upcoming Cross Island Line interchange (CR17) — a genuine appreciation catalyst, and the dual-key layout supports the 'high rental yield' pitch (one key let, one occupied). But $2,209 psf is full new-launch pricing with the upside largely priced in, the $2.9M quantum sits above the deepest buyer band, and there's no resale track. Score_1000 444 reflects the rich entry. A quality, well-located asset but not a value buy — Neutral.
